title: A flash of red
description: Ripe berries grow at the edge of the clearing. A few unfamiliar fruits hide among the leaves.

choices.label: Pick the familiar berries
choices.description: A small, dependable meal.
choices.result: You eat the ripe berries and keep a handful of useful fibers.

choices.label: Gather everything
choices.description: More food, if your instincts are right.
choices.result: Your instincts were right. A generous meal awaits.
choices.failureResult: The bitter fruit leaves you sick and shaken.

choices.label: Dig roots and herbs
choices.description: Your knife reaches what hands cannot.
choices.result: You cut starchy roots and bundle two healing herbs.

title: Follow the water
description: A shallow stream runs over smooth stones. You can collect water and boil it back at the campfire.

choices.label: Collect and boil water
choices.description: Return to camp with a full flask.
choices.result: The fire does its work. Clean water has never tasted so good.

choices.label: Search the riverbank
choices.description: Useful materials lie between the roots.
choices.result: You bring back smooth stones, dry branches, and a little water.

choices.label: Cut riverside herbs
choices.description: Medicinal leaves grow among the reeds.
choices.result: You drink from the stream and carry back fragrant herbs and reeds.

title: Gifts of the canopy
description: Last night's wind scattered branches and coconuts across the trail. There is only time to carry so much.

choices.label: Crack the coconuts
choices.description: Fresh water and a little food.
choices.result: You split the shells on a rock and enjoy the fresh coconut.

choices.label: Bundle the branches
choices.description: Keep the campfire burning tonight.
choices.result: A bundle of dry wood and long fibers makes the walk worthwhile.

choices.label: Chop the fallen tree
choices.description: Split the trunk into solid firewood.
choices.result: The axe bites deep. You haul back a heavy load of wood.

title: Someone was here
description: A weathered backpack hangs from a broken branch. Its straps are tangled high above the trail.

choices.label: Search the open pocket
choices.description: Take what you can reach safely.
choices.result: A sealed ration and a length of cord. Someone else's loss is your lifeline.

choices.label: Climb for the whole bag
choices.description: A better haul, but the branch is fragile.
choices.result: You recover the bag: rations, water, and sturdy cord.
choices.failureResult: The branch snaps. You land hard, and the bag tumbles out of reach.

choices.label: Leave it behind
choices.description: The walk still costs daylight and supplies.
choices.result: You mark the trail and return safely to camp.

choices.label: Tend your wounds
choices.description: Use a herb from the bag before moving on.
choices.result: You crush the herb into a poultice. The pain eases and the bag can wait.

title: Snake on the trail
description: A green coil moves beneath the leaves. Beyond it, a small spring glints in the sunlight.

choices.label: Take the long way around
choices.description: Reach the spring without disturbing it.
choices.result: You give the snake plenty of room and fill your flask at the spring.

choices.label: Throw a stone
choices.description: Spend a stone to drive it away.
choices.result: The snake slips into the brush. You gather wood beside the spring.

choices.label: Back away
choices.description: Return by the trail you know.
choices.result: You return empty-handed, but unharmed.

title: The broken bridge
description: Old ropes span a narrow ravine. On the other side, an abandoned supply crate rests in the shade.

choices.label: Trust the ropes
choices.description: The crate could hold precious supplies.
choices.result: The bridge holds. You carry the crate's supplies back one careful step at a time.
choices.failureResult: A rope gives way. You scramble back, bruised and trembling.

choices.label: Salvage the loose ropes
choices.description: Stay on solid ground.
choices.result: You collect useful rope and boards without crossing the ravine.

title: The last drop
description: Your flask is nearly empty. Water trickles down a mossy rock face, but you cannot tell where it comes from.

choices.label: Bring water back to boil
choices.description: Use dry wood to make it safe.
choices.result: You return to the fire and boil enough water to refill your flask.

choices.label: Drink from the rock
choices.description: Relief now, with a chance of sickness.
choices.result: The water is cool and clear. You feel your strength returning.
choices.failureResult: The water eases your thirst, but soon your stomach cramps.

choices.label: Return to the clearing
choices.description: Try foraging near camp instead.
choices.result: You turn back, saving your strength for another search.

title: The last embers
description: The jungle grows louder as the fire fades. A little fuel could keep the darkness at bay.

choices.label: Feed the fire
choices.description: Trade two wood for a calmer night.
choices.result: Flames rise above the stones. For a moment, this clearing feels like home.

choices.label: Rekindle with your torch
choices.description: Resin catches fast and burns bright.
choices.result: The torch flares and the fire roars back to life without using your wood.

choices.label: Save the wood
choices.description: Let the fire fade and shelter in the dark.
choices.result: You pull the bedroll close and listen to unfamiliar calls until dawn.

choices.label: Steady your breathing
choices.description: Count slowly until the shaking stops.
choices.result: You count the embers instead of the shadows. The night feels a little smaller.

title: Something outside
description: Leaves rustle just beyond the firelight. Something stops, listens, then moves again.

choices.label: Stay perfectly still
choices.description: Wait for the visitor to pass.
choices.result: The footsteps fade. Whatever it was, it has moved on.

choices.label: Hold up your torch
choices.description: Light pushes back whatever waits outside.
choices.result: Eyes glint and vanish. At the edge of the light you find a dropped branch.

choices.label: Look beyond the firelight
choices.description: Curiosity might settle your nerves.
choices.result: Only a small lizard. You laugh quietly and bring back a fallen branch.
choices.failureResult: A startled animal darts past. You stumble through thorns on your way back.

choices.label: Hold on tight
choices.description: Only a steady mind can stay still this long.
choices.result: You keep perfectly still until the sound moves on without you.

title: Rain on the roof
description: A sudden downpour pushes through the leaves of your shelter. Water begins to pool beside the bedroll.

choices.label: Tie down fresh leaves
choices.description: Use two fibers to keep the shelter dry.
choices.result: The patched roof holds. You even collect a little clean rainwater.

choices.label: Wait out the rain
choices.description: An uncomfortable night beneath the leaves.
choices.result: You save what rainwater you can, then curl up in the driest corner.

title: Along the riverbank
description: Dry branches lie above the waterline. Beneath them, long vines and wriggling worms promise a useful haul.

choices.label: Gather fishing supplies
choices.description: Enough materials for a Basic Rod, plus bait.
choices.result: You bundle branches and fibers, and tuck two worms into a leaf pouch.

choices.label: Collect and boil water
choices.description: Fill your flask and pick up a little bait.
choices.result: You bring clean water and a fresh worm back to camp.

choices.label: Return to camp
choices.description: The round trip still costs 2 daylight.
choices.result: You retrace your steps to the clearing.

title: Beneath the roots
description: A fallen tree exposes a tangle of vines beside the stream. Worms stir in the damp soil.

choices.label: Collect branches, vines and bait
choices.description: Build your fishing supplies.
choices.result: You return with sturdy branches, flexible vines, and three worms.

choices.label: Gather coconuts and water
choices.description: A little food and water for the walk home.
choices.result: You eat a coconut and refill your flask, keeping the stone you used to crack the shell.

title: Eyes in the grass
description: A jaguar steps onto the trail and stops. It is watching your pack, and it is in no hurry. The next move is yours.

choices.label: Wave the torch
choices.description: Fire frightens it more than hunger does.
choices.result: The jaguar flinches from the flame and melts back into the leaves.

choices.label: Hold your ground
choices.description: A spear keeps it at a distance. Maybe long enough.
choices.result: One clean thrust ends the standoff. You will not go hungry tonight.
choices.failureResult: The jaguar is faster. You stumble away bleeding, and your pack is left behind.

choices.label: Throw it meat
choices.description: A meal is easier than a fight.
choices.result: It drags the meat into the brush. You edge past, heart hammering.

choices.label: Back away slowly
choices.description: Drop the pack if you must. It is only things.
choices.result: You back away until the trail bends. The jungle keeps what you found.

title: Something in the leaves
description: The thicket ahead moves in a way the wind does not explain. A snake, thick as your wrist, lies across the only path.

choices.label: Cut it clear
choices.description: A good blade and a steady hand.
choices.result: You flip the snake aside with a branch and cut the vines in one stroke.

choices.label: Stand perfectly still
choices.description: Snakes strike what moves.
choices.result: It slides over your boot and is gone.
choices.failureResult: It strikes before you can breathe. The bite burns.

choices.label: Treat the bite
choices.description: A herb poultice stops the worst of it.
choices.result: The poultice draws the heat out. You can walk again.

choices.label: Go around
choices.description: It costs nerves, not blood.
choices.result: You circle wide through the brush and rejoin the trail beyond it.

title: Crash through the brush
description: Branches snap. A wild boar bursts onto the trail, head down, and it has already decided about you.

choices.label: Swing the axe
choices.description: Heavy, slow, and it has one chance.
choices.result: The axe lands true. It is a hard, ugly win, and a good meal.
choices.failureResult: It hits you low and you go down. By the time you stand, it is gone.

choices.label: Scramble up a branch
choices.description: Boars cannot climb. Branches break.
choices.result: It snorts below, loses interest, and trots away.
choices.failureResult: The branch gives. You land hard, and your pack tumbles into the mud and is gone.

choices.label: Toss it a fish
choices.description: A distraction you can afford.
choices.result: It stops to wrestle with the fish. You are already walking.

choices.label: Run for it
choices.description: Leave the pack and keep your legs.
choices.result: You run until the sound behind you fades. The pack is somewhere back there.

title: A grove of dark trunks
description: Beyond the river the trees change. The wood here is dense and almost black, nothing like the soft branches near camp.

choices.label: Chop hardwood
choices.description: Only a real axe will bite.
choices.result: The axe rings. You split three solid lengths of hardwood and take a little more.

choices.label: Pry loose bark
choices.description: A single hard branch and some cordage.
choices.result: You pry off bark and a single hard branch. It is something.

choices.label: Take what has fallen
choices.description: Soft wood and a few good stones.
choices.result: You gather dry wood and one good stone from the roots.

title: A glade of pale flowers
description: The air changes. Pale flowers cover a quiet glade, and the plants between them smell of bitter medicine.

choices.label: Cut herbs and roots
choices.description: A knife takes the whole plant.
choices.result: You cut a bundle of herbs and dig starchy roots.

choices.label: Pluck a few leaves
choices.description: Gentle hands, small reward.
choices.result: You pluck what you can reach without tearing the plant.

choices.label: Rest in the quiet
choices.description: Nothing here wants anything from you.
choices.result: For a few minutes the jungle is only a place.

title: A hidden pool
description: The stream widens into a still green pool. Shapes move slowly under the surface.

choices.label: Drink deeply
choices.description: Cold, clean, and nobody else's.
choices.result: It tastes of stone and rain.

choices.label: Catch fish by hand
choices.description: Slow hands and a lot of patience.
choices.result: Two slippery fish, both kept, one nearly lost.
choices.failureResult: Every fish is somewhere else. You drink instead.

choices.label: Collect smooth stones
choices.description: Good for tools, and heavy.
choices.result: You wade the shallows and fill your hands with round stones.

title: The broken cockpit
description: The nose of the plane lies in the roots like a split fruit. Instruments hang from wires. Something here is still worth taking.

choices.label: Pry the dashboard
choices.description: A real axe makes quick work of it.
choices.result: Panels give with a screech. You carry out more scrap than you expected.

choices.label: Search the cockpit
choices.description: Careful, with your hands.
choices.result: You work free two panels and some loose metal.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.description: Some places are better left alone.
choices.result: You walk back from the nose of the plane without looking at the seats.

title: The split cargo hold
description: Crates lie in the dirt, split open. Rain has been at them for weeks.

choices.label: Rummage the crates
choices.description: Metal, rope, and not much else.
choices.result: You find scrap, a coil of rope, and a lot of ruined paper.

choices.label: Check the seats
choices.description: You may find something. You may find a name.
choices.result: An unopened snack pack, and a name you try not to read.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.description: You have enough to carry.
choices.result: You step out of the hold and into the light.

title: The tail section
description: The tail stands almost whole, nose-down in the ferns. There is a lot of good metal here, and a lot of dark inside.

choices.label: Unbolt the panels
choices.description: Hard work, but it comes away clean.
choices.result: You work the bolts loose and carry out a stack of panels.

choices.label: Crawl inside
choices.description: The best scrap is in the dark.
choices.result: You squeeze through the dark and come out with more than you can carry.
choices.failureResult: Something gives. You scrape out bruised, with nothing to show.

choices.label: Strip the wiring
choices.description: Quick and safe. Less to show for it.
choices.result: You peel back the cladding and pull out what you can reach.

title: Between the green stems
description: Young shoots push through fallen leaves. Dry bamboo canes lie nearby, but the thick stems need a sharp edge.

choices.label: Cut young shoots
choices.description: Cut young shoots.
choices.result: Your knife frees tender shoots and a bundle of straight canes.

choices.label: Gather dry canes
choices.description: Gather dry canes.
choices.result: You bundle the dry canes and peel useful fibers from their bark.

choices.label: Return to camp
choices.description: Return to camp.
choices.result: You retrace the path to camp before the grove grows darker.

title: A wall of bamboo
description: The trail narrows into an interwoven thicket. A fallen trunk blocks the way; small green leaves grow beneath it.

choices.label: Split the canes
choices.description: Split the canes.
choices.result: The axe opens the thicket. You collect solid wood from the fallen trunk.

choices.label: Peel loose bark
choices.description: Peel loose bark.
choices.result: Long strips of bark pull free without disturbing the thicket.

choices.label: Crawl beneath
choices.description: Crawl beneath.
choices.result: You slip under the trunk and find useful herbs in the damp soil.
choices.failureResult: A hidden splinter catches your arm. You squeeze out with nothing new to carry.

title: What the tide left
description: Branches and reeds have washed against a dry root. Small movements stir the mud beside the pile.

choices.label: Gather driftwood
choices.description: Gather driftwood.
choices.result: You collect weathered wood and tough reed fibers from the dry bank.

choices.label: Search the mud
choices.description: Search the mud.
choices.result: You scoop worms from the soft mud and pick up a smooth stone.

choices.label: Return to camp
choices.description: Return to camp.
choices.result: You follow the dry roots back to camp with your pack intact.

title: Water between the roots
description: A shallow pool sits beneath a web of roots. Fish flicker in the shade while broad medicinal leaves grow along the bank.

choices.label: Cut the reeds
choices.description: Cut the reeds.
choices.result: You cut a bundle of medicinal leaves and long reed fibers.

choices.label: Lure the fish
choices.description: Lure the fish.
choices.result: The fish follow your bait into the shallows. You catch two before they scatter.
choices.failureResult: You slip between the roots. The bait drifts away while you scramble back onto the bank.

choices.label: Search the bank
choices.description: Search the bank.
choices.result: Smooth stones and a handful of worms fill the empty corner of your pack.

choices.label: Return to camp
choices.description: Return to camp.
choices.result: You leave the still pool behind and make your way home.

title: A ripple without wind
description: A long shape rises from the shallows. A crocodile slides toward the bank, closing the gap between you and the water.

choices.label: Throw a fish
choices.description: Throw a fish.
choices.result: The crocodile turns toward the fish. You step back onto the dry trail.

choices.label: Brace the spear
choices.description: Brace the spear.
choices.result: You keep the spear between yourself and the jaws until the crocodile retreats.
choices.failureResult: The jaws snap past the spear. You flee toward camp, wounded, leaving the haul behind.

choices.label: Climb the roots
choices.description: Climb the roots.
choices.result: The roots hold. You climb above the water and pass along the dry bank.
choices.failureResult: A wet root gives way. You recover your footing, but your gathered supplies sink into the water.

choices.label: Back away
choices.description: Back away.
choices.result: You backtrack to camp, keeping your pack well away from the water.

title: The buzzing branch
description: A papery nest hangs across the trail. The branch trembles as a swarm pours out into the warm air.

choices.label: Raise the torch
choices.description: Raise the torch.
choices.result: Smoke rolls across the nest. The swarm parts long enough for you to pass.
choices.failureResult: A gust clears the smoke. A few stings send you ducking beneath the branch.

choices.label: Weave a cover
choices.description: Weave a cover.
choices.result: You weave a loose cover from the fibers and pass with your face protected.

choices.label: Wait quietly
choices.description: Wait quietly.
choices.result: You crouch beyond the nest until the swarm settles, then slip past.

choices.label: Turn back
choices.description: Turn back.
choices.result: You choose the open path back to camp rather than crossing beneath the nest.

title: Small hands, quick feet
description: Two monkeys dart onto the path. One grabs a loose pack strap while the other watches the opening.

choices.label: Share a ration
choices.description: Share a ration.
choices.result: The monkeys seize the offered food and let your pack go.

choices.label: Guard the pack
choices.description: Guard the pack.
choices.result: You cut the snagged strap free and pull the pack safely against your chest.
choices.failureResult: A sharp bite makes you let go. The monkeys scatter with everything gathered on this trip.

choices.label: Pull it free
choices.description: Pull it free.
choices.result: You wrestle the strap back and collect a length of vine torn loose in the scuffle.
choices.failureResult: The strap slips out of your hands. Your haul disappears into the canopy.

choices.label: Leave the haul
choices.description: Leave the haul.
choices.result: You let the gathered supplies go and walk back to camp without another struggle.
